body:
Found in task:2414798176c466e4, run 9f6696d0464e5adc, step 19. A failed `extract` returned a 115,111-character reply. Most of it came from `group_errors` (`diagnostics.group_errors`), which lists every site of every shared cause. For example, `` `0` is private on `Failure` (115 places) `` printed all 115 `at …` lines. A reply that size floods a weaker model's context and hides the one line that matters: the fix.

- For each grouped cause, list only the first few sites (for example 5). Then add one line like `… and 110 more in board, drafts, lockdown`, naming the modules.
- Keep the cause line and its fix exactly as they are now.

### Done when

- A unit test with one cause at many sites shows the cap and the `… more` line.
- The existing `grouped_privacy_errors_name_the_fix_once` test still passes.
- `check --warnings` and `rust-unit` pass.
title: errors: cap grouped site lists
